description: Browser automation scenarios. Single source for the specs (tag @<id>), the runner (scripts/scenarios.mjs) and the generated page public/scenarios.html. Synthetic data only.

groups.title: Investigation stories
groups.summary: Open each preloaded case and follow it the way an investigator would.

groups.title: The multi-agent team at work
groups.summary: See which specialists ran, in what order, and what the local AI wrote.

groups.title: AI-designed stories
groups.summary: Invent your own story or let an AI red team try to beat the rules—code builds and checks everything.

groups.title: Everyday workspace use
groups.summary: Start new work, find cases, share links and use a phone.

groups.title: Safety and honesty
groups.summary: Check what the tool refuses to do and how it behaves when things go wrong.

scenarios.title: Suspicious transfer pattern → report consideration
scenarios.story: ACC-4471 receives several deposits just under $10,000 and moves money on. The team scores it 100/100 and stops for a human.
checks: Score 100/100 with a rule-by-rule breakdown
Money in $38,300 and out $28,000
Every finding names its specialist and source
Draft is marked as not filed
Workflow stops at the human checkpoint

scenarios.title: Routine transfer closes automatically
scenarios.story: ACC-0001 is an ordinary $3,000 payment. The team scores it 15/100 and closes it without involving a human.
checks: Score 15/100 → no escalation
Evidence critic is skipped
Case closes automatically with no human approval recorded

scenarios.title: Screening hit puts the case on hold
scenarios.story: ACC-9999 involves a name on the illustrative screening list. The case is held until a human resolves it.
checks: Recommendation is Hold
Screening method is labelled illustrative, not a live sanctions service
Suspicious names appear as plain text, never as hidden markers

scenarios.title: Borderline case goes to review
scenarios.story: ACC-0040 has some signals but not enough for a report. The team recommends a human review.
checks: Score 40/100 → review recommended
Needs your decision
Signals worth a closer look are listed

scenarios.title: Follow the specialist team step by step
scenarios.story: Walk agent by agent through the transfer-pattern case and see what each specialist received and recorded.
checks: The path matches the recorded run, in order
Next and Previous agent navigation work end to end
Timeline shows measured durations

scenarios.title: One team, four decision paths
scenarios.story: Compare the four recorded runs side by side, then jump into one of them.
checks: All four outcomes come from real runs
"Open recorded run" lands on that case

scenarios.title: AI writes, code verifies
scenarios.story: With the local model on, the AI writes each draft sentence and code checks it against verified facts. Without the model, the app says so honestly.
checks: Every sentence shows the facts it cites
Sentences the verifier caught are shown, not hidden
Model, attempts and timing are visible
Without a model the draft is labelled stub narration

scenarios.title: Ask for policy references without changing a case
scenarios.story: Ask about a screening hold, inspect exact local notes and their background links, then try an unrelated question. LangChain retrieves, the local AI selects when available, and case decisions remain unchanged.
checks: Case snapshot is separate from educational guidance
Every displayed passage has a local reference ID and source type
Unrelated questions abstain rather than inventing an answer
Risk score, recommendation and case activity remain unchanged

scenarios.title: Invent a story and test the AI's prediction
scenarios.story: Describe a situation in plain English. The local model designs a bounded recipe and predicts the outcome before the run; code builds the transactions and the same agent team decides.
checks: The four-step pipeline is explained before anything runs
Code-built transactions use synthetic STORY- identifiers within bounds
The locked prediction is compared with the team's actual result

scenarios.title: Let an AI red team try to beat the rules
scenarios.story: A red-team agent gets up to three rounds, learning which rules fired each time. The team investigates its best valid attempt and the result is scored honestly: caught, partly caught or slipped past.
checks: Every round shows money moved, rule score and the rules that fired
Exactly one attempt is marked as investigated
The verdict matches the team's real recommendation, with blind spots explained

scenarios.title: Story studio guardrails
scenarios.story: Try a too-short story and one that hides an instruction. The studio refuses the first and neutralises the second before any model sees it.
checks: Too-short stories cannot be submitted
Instruction-like text is flagged and redacted
The case is still an ordinary synthetic investigation

scenarios.title: First visit: get oriented
scenarios.story: A newcomer opens the workspace, reads how it works and finds the beginner's guide.
checks: Synthetic environment is clearly labelled
"How it works" explains the workflow
Beginner's guide opens

scenarios.title: Start a brand-new investigation
scenarios.story: Pick a practice scenario, run the whole team live and watch the case arrive in the queue.
checks: New case appears in the queue
Live status ends at the human checkpoint
Specialist findings are filled in

scenarios.title: Find cases with search and filters
scenarios.story: Narrow the queue by account, party name and lifecycle state.
checks: Search by account and by party
Filter by lifecycle
Clear message when nothing matches

scenarios.title: Share a link to a case
scenarios.story: Open a link straight to a case draft, reload the page, then go back a step.
checks: Link opens the exact case and tab
Reload keeps your place
Browser Back returns to the previous step

scenarios.title: Use it on a phone
scenarios.story: Follow a whole case journey on a 390-pixel-wide phone screen.
checks: No sideways scrolling on any step
All four steps reachable

scenarios.title: Nothing is filed; decisions need a named human
scenarios.story: Confirm the tool never files a report, only accepts a decision with a name, a reason and a checklist, and refuses customer data from the browser.
checks: No control files a report; Submit stays disabled until the decision is complete
Code blocks actions the policy does not allow, and says why
The browser cannot send customer data, incomplete decisions or cross-site commands

scenarios.title: Record a decision with four-eyes escalation
scenarios.story: A screening HOLD reaches you. Find the decision panel, see why closing is blocked, escalate it, then finish it as a different senior reviewer.
checks: The banner says a decision is needed and Go to decision opens the panel
A HOLD cannot be closed at level 1; the reason is shown
The same person cannot finish their own escalation
The case closes with a named decision history

scenarios.title: When a case or the connection goes missing
scenarios.story: Open a case that no longer exists, then lose the connection to the analysis service and get it back.
checks: A missing case is explained
Lost connection shows Retry and marks data as stale
Retry recovers once the service is back
